title: What If Every Wasp Vanished? You'd Miss Them

scenes.text: What if every wasp vanished? You'd miss them sooner than you think.
There are roughly thirty-three thousand species of stinging wasps, and most of them aren't the ones at your picnic.
Ninety-seven percent are solitary, and each species typically hunts one kind of prey.
They hunt aphids and caterpillars, the pests that eat crops.
Some orchids rely on wasps to be pollinated, and a few even mimic the back end of a female wasp.
Without wasps, more pests and fewer flowers. The insect everyone swats keeps the world running.
